sql_query:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS month,
    ABS(SUM(op.payment_value)) AS total_revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  WHERE
    o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
    AND date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) >= date_trunc('month', current_date) - INTERVAL '11 months'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  month,
  total_revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN prev_total IS NULL OR prev_total = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE 100.0 * (total_revenue - prev_total) / prev_total
  END AS mom_growth_pct
FROM (
  SELECT
    month,
    total_revenue,
    LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_total
  FROM monthly
) t
ORDER BY month;
